paper_metadata.title: A review on the effect of various rolling regimes (cryo, cold, warm, hot) and post-annealing on high-entropy alloys: microstructure evolution, deformation mechanisms, and mechanical properties
paper_metadata.journal: Archives of Civil and Mechanical Engineering
